nodes.name: Coprecipitation of NiFe-LDH(NO3-)
nodes.procedure: The alkaline solution (1.714 M NaOH, 0.5 M NaNO3) and the mixed metal salt solution (0.67 M Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.33 M Fe(NO3)3·9H2O, Ni:Fe = 2:1) were added dropwise to 80 mL deionized (DI) water at 60 °C oil bath under nitrogen atmosphere. By adjusting the drop rates of the above two solutions, the pH value in the reaction system was maintained at about 8.5 (monitored by the pH meter). After adding 60 mL of the mixed salt solution dropwise, the reaction solution was further subjected to 60 °C oil bath under a nitrogen atmosphere for 6 h. The yellow turbid solution was centrifuged at 8000 r.p.m. for 5 min, and was washed with DI water and absolute ethanol several times, which was dried at 80 °C for 8 h in vacuum. The finally obtained yellowish powder was NiFe-LDH (NO3-).
nodes.source_text: The precursors were synthesized by coprecipitation method. The alkaline solution and the mixed metal salt solution were added dropwise to 80 mL deionized (DI) water at 60 °C oil bath under nitrogen atmosphere... The finally obtained yellowish powder was NiFe-LDH (NO3-).

nodes.name: Exfoliation-reassembly of NiFe-LDH(POM)
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared NiFe-LDH (NO3-) powder (0.2 g) was added to the 200 mL formamide solution and magnetically stirred under N2 for 48 h. Furthermore, 20 mL aqueous solution of phosphotungstic acid (HPW) (including 0.7 g phosphotungstic acid particles) and 20 mL DI water was mixed, and the stirring was maintained for 24 h under N2 atmosphere. Finally, the solution was centrifuged, washed and dried using the same procedures as the treated precursor (centrifuged at 8000 rpm for 5 min, washed with DI water and absolute ethanol, dried at 80 °C for 8 h in vacuum). Obtained powders were termed as NiFe-LDH (POM).

nodes.name: Exfoliation-reassembly control (NO3--T)
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared NiFe-LDH (NO3-) powder was subjected to the same exfoliation (200 mL formamide, N2, 48 h stirring) and reassembly (20 mL DI water instead of HPW solution, N2, 24 h stirring) process as NiFe-LDH(POM), followed by centrifugation, washing and drying using the same procedures as the precursor (8000 rpm for 5 min, DI water/ethanol wash, 80 °C vacuum drying for 8 h). NiFe-LDH (NO3--T) was prepared to investigate the effect of exfoliation and self-recombination process on electrochemical performance.

nodes.characterization_summary: All samples display characteristic LDH peaks (JCPDS 40-0215); NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻) (003) at 10.8° (d=0.81 nm); NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻-T) (003) at 11.2°; NiFe-LDH (POM) (003) peaks at ~7.6° (d=1.15 nm, PW₁₂O₄₀³⁻) and 10-12° (CO₃²⁻/NO₃⁻).
nodes.evidence_snippet: both NiFe-LDH (POM), NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻-T) and their precursor NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻) display characteristic peaks of the LDH material (JCPDS card no. 40-0215 NiFe-LDH (CO₃²⁻)) ... The (003) peak of NiFe-LDH (POM) appears in the range of 7°-12° in 2q in XRD.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻) nitrate at 1384 cm⁻¹; NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻-T) carbonate 1360 cm⁻¹, nitrate 1384 cm⁻¹; NiFe-LDH (POM) shows phosphotungstate characteristic peaks <1500 cm⁻¹ (Fig. S2) confirming PW₁₂O₄₀³⁻.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the infrared spectrum of NiFe-LDH(NO₃⁻), it shows the strong nitrate characteristic peak is located at 1384 cm⁻¹ ... Characteristic peaks of phosphotungstic acid can be observed in the amplified infrared spectrum (Fig. S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: Both NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻) and NiFe-LDH (POM) show typical lamellar structure, but NiFe-LDH (POM) exhibits apparent agglomeration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 3a and b, it can be observed that the LDH material has a typical lamellar structure, but NiFe-LDH (POM) exhibits apparent agglomeration relative to the precursor.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe-LDH (POM) shows even distribution of Ni, Fe, W, P, and O elements confirming successful POM intercalation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The elements of Ni, Fe, W, P, and O are evenly distributed in NiFe-LDH (POM) (Fig. 3c), which further validates the successful introduction of (PW₁₂O₄₀)³⁻ into the LDH layers.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe-LDH (POM) specific surface area decreased compared to NiFe-LDH (NO₃⁻) precursor (Fig. S5, Table S1).
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the results of Fig. S5 and Table S1, it indicates that the specific surface area of NiFe-LDH (POM) is decreased compared to the precursor.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe-LDH (POM): Ni²⁺ (856/874 eV, Ni 2p1/2 +0.5 eV shift), Fe³⁺ (both Fe 2p3/2 and 2p1/2), W⁶⁺ (4f7/2, 4f5/2 -0.7 eV shift); O 1s includes POM oxygen at 532.1 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution XPS spectrum of Ni, Fe, W (Fig. 4b, c, d), it indicates that the elements in NiFe-LDH (POM) are in the forms of Ni²⁺, Fe³⁺, W⁶⁺, respectively ... The oxygen peak in NiFe-LDH (POM) (Fig. 4f) contains ... oxygen-derived form (PW₁₂O₄₀)³⁻ at 532.1 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe-LDH (POM) shows slightly smaller Ni:Fe ratio compared to precursor.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni:Fe value in NiFe-LDH (POM) is slightly smaller compared to its precursor (Table S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: After 500 CV cycles, NiFe-LDH (POM) retains 30-35% POM content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: SEM-EDS characterizations were collected, showing that 30-35% POM were remained in the catalyst even after aging for 500 CV cycles at 50 mV/s (Fig. S10).
